items.title: Reports Indicate McDonald's App Sending Unauthorized Notifications
items.summary: Users have reported receiving promotional push notifications and Live Activities from the McDonald's app even when notifications are disabled.
items.content: Reports have emerged indicating that the McDonald's mobile app is sending promotional push notifications and utilizing Live Activities to display advertisements to iPhone users, even when those users have explicitly disabled notification permissions. The issue, which has also been observed with other retail and restaurant apps, raises questions regarding compliance with Apple's App Store guidelines, which generally prohibit the use of push notifications for marketing without user consent. While the technical cause remains unclear, the reports suggest a potential conflict between app functionality and iOS notification settings.

items.title: Families File Lawsuit Against Uber Following Fatal Arizona Collision
items.summary: Families of victims involved in a 2025 Arizona car crash have filed a lawsuit against Uber, alleging negligence in driver screening and supervision.
items.content: A lawsuit has been filed in Pima County Superior Court against Uber Technologies, Inc. following a fatal October 2025 collision in Tucson, Arizona. The complaint alleges that the company failed to adequately screen, qualify, train, and supervise the driver involved in the accident, which resulted in the deaths of four individuals, including two Uber passengers and a minor. The plaintiffs contend that Uber did not exercise reasonable care in monitoring its drivers, raising concerns about the company's safety protocols for transporting passengers. The litigation seeks to address these alleged failures and hold the company accountable for the incident.

items.title: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. Appoints Cheng Sin Yi as Co-Chief Executive Officer
items.summary: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. has appointed Cheng Sin Yi as Co-Chief Executive Officer, effective November 21, 2026, as part of a leadership transition.
items.content: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. (Nasdaq: NXAT) announced the appointment of Ms. Cheng Sin Yi as Co-Chief Executive Officer, effective November 21, 2026. As part of this leadership change, Myungjong Kim has stepped down from his role as of the same date, and current Co-CEO Ted Kim is scheduled to step down at the beginning of next year. Ms. Cheng brings over 15 years of experience in finance, corporate management, and capital markets to the company. The company stated that her appointment is intended to strengthen its financial foundation, governance, and efforts to meet Nasdaq continued listing requirements.

items.title: Investigation into Alleged Deliberate Methane Releases at Chevron Facilities
items.summary: A probe has identified instances of methane plumes at Chevron facilities that were allegedly released deliberately.
items.content: An investigation has reportedly uncovered evidence of methane plumes at Chevron-operated sites that were characterized as being deliberately released. This finding raises concerns regarding operational practices and environmental compliance. The company is now facing scrutiny over these specific emissions events, which have been highlighted in recent reports.
